content.text:
deb [ signed-by=/usr/local/share/keyrings/postgres.gpg.asc ] http://apt.postgresql.org/pub/repos/apt bookworm-pgdg main 17
---
VERSION_CODENAME=bookworm
/usr/bin/pg_isready
PGDATA=/var/lib/postgresql/data
clusterdb
createdb
createuser
dropdb
dropuser
initdb
oid2name
pg_amcheck
pg_archivecleanup
pg_basebackup

observation.command: docker run --rm postgres:17-bookworm sh -c 'cat /etc/apt/sources.list.d/pgdg.list 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; cat /etc/os-release | grep VERSION_CODENAME; which pg_isready; echo "PGDATA=$PGDATA"; ls /usr/lib/postgresql/17/bin/ | head' 2>&1 | tail -20
